fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2026-02-07, the spouse of the complainant, Chithra Ammal, aged 22, left for work and did not return; the last known location was near Iniyan Puram College Road. The time of the incident was given as 10:20 on 2026-02-07. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Vignesh Balan (9000000105), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs. The mobile number 9000000105 appears in FIR-2026-00195 in a different capacity and may be relevant to this matter.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone reportedly switched off after the last known call.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, photograph, associate, morning, college road
